name: fig-viewer
description: Open pickled Matplotlib .fig files in VS Code with an interactive WebAgg viewer.

figViewer.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used to load `.fig` files. Leave empty to fall back to `figViewer.condaEnv` and then to a workspace virtualenv / `python3`.

figViewer.condaEnv.markdownDescription: Conda environment name to resolve an interpreter from (via `conda run -n <env> python`). Used only when `figViewer.pythonPath` is empty. The environment must have `matplotlib` (with `tornado`) installed.

figViewer.extraPythonArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments inserted before the server script when launching Python (for example `-u` for unbuffered output).
